column2: Retain the report of Roman strength, welcome and friendship, including the repeated mighty in strength at the end. Reputation naturally renders name here without deleting the deliberate repetition.

Retain the unnamed narrators recounting wars, bravery among the Galatians and tribute. The present deeds within a report are naturally backshifted; the people-name is not replaced by a reconstructed ethnic geography.
Retain Spain and the purpose of gaining control of silver/gold mines. The mineral resources and motive remain explicit, without a modern place gloss.
Retain counsel, perseverance, remoteness, defeated kings and annual tribute. The difficult long genitive continuation is unfolded as control over kings without inventing their names.
Retain Philip, Perseus king of the Kittians and the others rising against Rome. Kittians is the selected designation, not silently replaced by Macedonians as a historical correction.
Retain Antiochus the Great, Asia, one hundred twenty elephants, cavalry, chariots and a very large force, followed by defeat. These are the report’s claims, not a modern historical reconstruction.
Retain capture alive, tribute from king and successors, hostages and territorial settlement. The last term remains provisional and is not expanded into detailed treaty boundaries.
column3: What does the distinction/separation term designate here: boundary settlement, cession or another imposed obligation? The next unit informs context but does not settle the noun alone.

column2: Retain India, Media and Lydia, their quality and transfer to Eumenes. Do not replace the printed geographic names with historically more plausible territories.

Propose They also reported that the people of Greece had resolved to come and destroy the Romans. The Greek and that continues the report to Judas from verse 2; inherited They also heard risks making a new hearing event or Roman subject. Romans clarifies the threatened pronoun contextually.

Retain Roman discovery, one general, many wounded, captive wives/children, plunder, subjection, demolished forts and enslavement to this day. Wounded is not changed to killed, and the full chain of coercive actions remains.

Retain destruction/enslavement of resisting kingdoms and islands, contrasted with maintained friendship toward allies and those relying on Rome. The report’s contrast is not turned into a translator’s endorsement.
Retain kings near and far and fear among all hearing the Roman name. The merism and broad reported scope remain.

Retain Rome’s help toward kingship and removal of rulers, and great exaltation. The inherited help and have as kings supplies the infinitive’s contextual subject without asserting an extra coronation ceremony.
column3: How precisely does the infinitive reign depend on wish/help? The fluent inherited resolution remains provisional.

column2: Retain not one wearing a diadem or purple for self-magnification. Do not correct the report to an external reconstruction of Roman insignia or offices.
Retain a council chamber, three hundred twenty councillors, daily continuing deliberation and good order for the people. The selected count is not normalized to another senate total.
Retain one entrusted ruler each year, all obeying the one and no envy/rivalry. The source’s singular ruler and idealized harmony remain; historical correction would alter the report.
Retain Eupolemus son of John son of Accos and Jason son of Eleazar, sent for friendship and alliance. The two genealogical chains remain distinct and provisional in spelling.
Retain removing the yoke and Greek-kingdom enslavement of Israel in servitude. The repeated servitude wording and bodily yoke image remain.
Retain the very long journey, entry into the council chamber and speech. Spoke naturally expresses the answering/speaking formula without inventing a prior question.
Retain the envoys’ principals, alliance/peace and request for enrollment as allies and friends. The plural us may represent the Jewish body rather than only the two individuals.
Retain the proposal pleasing the Roman recipients. No vote count or formal procedural detail is supplied.
Retain the copied letter, bronze tablets, Jerusalem destination and memorial of peace/alliance. The material and archival purpose are explicit.
Retain the wish for wellbeing on sea and dry land forever, and distance of sword/enemy. The optative greeting remains a wish rather than an unconditional prediction.
Retain war arising first for Rome or its allies across the dominion. Any in the conditional naturally distributes the source’s all without restricting the allied group.
Retain Jewish military assistance as circumstances prescribe and with a full heart. Wholeheartedly gives the heart idiom natural force without removing the practical condition.

Retain prohibition on grain, weapons, money and ships to those fighting, Rome’s decision and obligations with nothing received. Do not insert a definite enemy identity or payment category absent from the clause.
column3: Who precisely are those fighting, whose obligations are meant, and does receiving nothing mean no payment or another benefit? The treaty references remain open.

column2: Retain the reciprocal Roman assistance when war comes first to the Jews, from the soul and subject to circumstances. With all their soul is an idiomatic English rendering, not an independently stated all.
column3: The publisher punctuation ends this unit with a semicolon/question sign; should it function as a question or continuation in this treaty? The inherited declarative reading is provisional.

column2: Retain the difficult prohibition concerning those acting as allies, rather than silently substituting enemies. Keep the same four supplies, Roman decision and no deceit.
column3: Whose allies are the recipients prohibited from receiving supplies? The selected text does not expressly add the enemy possessive, and full treaty interpretation remains pending.

column2: Retain the terms by which Rome established the arrangement with the Jewish people. Agreement supplies the contextual object of the establishment verb without adding another document.
Retain both parties choosing additions/removals and their binding force. Both parties expresses these and these without replacing mutual agreement with unilateral Roman control.
Retain the shift to Roman we in the letter about Demetrius and the heavy-yoke question. Ordinary human you addresses the king; friends/allies remains the diplomatic identification.
Retain further appeal, judgment for the Jews and Roman war by sea and land. The conditional remains and again is supported by the further/repeated complaint expression.
